parent_objective: audit M2378 overlay config-patch artifacts before any active application or validation route
blocked_by: M2378 materializes overlay config-patch artifacts but does not audit whether they are sufficient for a bounded next route
active config overwrite, repair execution, and reset validation remain blocked until config-patch artifacts are audited
supersedes: direct active config overwrite from config-patch artifacts without audit
direct repair execution or training from config-patch artifacts

public_gates: M2379 must audit M2378 config-patch summary, patch family counts, overlay namespaces, and claim boundary without applying patches
M2379 must identify the next bounded route or stop the branch

M2379 must keep active-config overwrite, repair execution, reset/rollout, ranking, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, current-sim verdict, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits overlay config-patch artifacts before any active config application or validation route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no active config overwrite, repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2378 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if overlay namespaces are missing or active config overwrite appears
stop if guardrail constraints are missing
stop if audit would route directly to training or ranking without bounded application/validation design
fallback_plan: route to config-patch schema repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded next design if artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if config-patch artifacts are insufficient to choose a route

allowed_updates: M2379 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2378 artifacts are accepted or rejected
patch family counts and overlay namespace counts are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2379 audits config-patch artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2379; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Config-patch artifacts remain engineering design artifacts until application and measured validation.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits config-patch artifacts but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded next design but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2379 cannot audit or route from config-patch artifacts
M2379 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2378 config-patch artifacts can decide the next bounded route without applying patches, executing repair, ranking, training, or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2378 output family counts, overlay namespaces, and guardrail exclusions are audited

active config overwrite, repair execution, ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, current-sim verdict, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2379 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2379 applies config patches or overwrites active config
M2379 executes repair levers or trains
M2379 ranks support policies or controller families
M2379 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2379 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2379 cannot decide next route from complete config-patch artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2378 config-patch artifacts

decision_rule: M2379 passes if it audits M2378 config-patch artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
